Members

ARIA_ATTRS

Frozen aria attribute-name map — sole declaration site for these tokens; consumers read members and never re-declare the strings (zero-hardcoding rules 4–5). Object.freeze makes the token contract immutable at runtime.

tree/treeitem/none — the ARIA treeview contract for the docs nav.
